_comment: Embench-IoT v2.0 reference baseline. Source: baseline-data/speed.json @ embench/embench-iot master. Reference platform: Cortex-M4 @ 16 MHz on STM32F4 Discovery. Values are reference run-times in milliseconds measured with gsf=16. For our gsf=1 runs, the official Embench speed score per benchmark is: speed_i = ref_ms[i] * 1000 / measured_cycles_i. The Embench Score is the geometric mean across all benchmarks (higher is better; 1.0 means equal to the M4 reference at its clock).
